name: Woodruff Family YMCA Camp Wepawaug
activities: Specialty camps: STEAM, Archery, Creative Crafts, Challenge Camp
description_short: The Woodruff Family YMCA's summer day camp, Camp Wepawaug, on 20 acres in Milford for children entering kindergarten through 9th grade. Campers swim every day and do gaga, ropes and rock wall, STEM, archery and arts and crafts, with weekly themes. Camp runs 9:00 to 3:30 with pre and post care.
refund_policy_summary: A $50 deposit per camper per week is due at registration and cannot be refunded or transferred.
special_needs_notes: The Y works with children of all abilities. Families of a child who needs social, behavioral or medical accommodations are asked to contact the Camp Director.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers swim every day. The brochure gives no swim test or pool details.

sessions.name: Splash of Colors Week (Jun 29 to Jul 3)

source.title: Woodruff Family YMCA | Central Connecticut Coast YMCA		Central Connecticut Coast YMCA
